messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Overdose can also cause QT prolongation and Torsade de Pointes, so heart monitoring with an ECG is recommended.
There is no specific antidote for hydroxyzine overdose.

B. 'has unknown risk duration': The risk associated with the subject drug is not known to continue beyond the specified duration of treatment.
C. 'has no equivalent dose for': There is no corresponding dose of the subject drug that matches the specified dose of the alternative drug.
D. 'has dosage restriction': The subject drug's dosage is limited or not studied beyond the specified level, indicating a lack of safety or efficacy data.
